_comment: Local-only target for running the suite against the reference implementation
on this machine. Produces a record with no CI provenance, which the site and
the MCP server both label NOT INDEPENDENTLY PRODUCED. Not evidence, by design.
bounceWindowSeconds is 60 rather than the spec default of 600 because a probe
on 2026-09-07 held a message to a NXDOMAIN address for 625 seconds and Resend's
last_event never left 'sent'. Their bounce notifications arrive by webhook and
are not surfaced on the retrieve endpoint, so this reference implementation
cannot observe bounces at all and no window length changes the answer. A longer
wait would buy the same INCONCLUSIVE more slowly.
